# Plan: add src/clamp.mjs

## Context
`npm test` (`node --test`) fails: tests/clamp.accept.test.mjs imports `../src/clamp.mjs`, which is missing. The test must stay byte-for-byte unchanged (SHA-256 a3866579…ce19, verified).

## Change
Create `src/clamp.mjs`:
```js
export function clamp(x, lo, hi) {
  if (lo > hi) throw new RangeError(`lo (${lo}) > hi (${hi})`);
  return Math.min(Math.max(x, lo), hi);
}
```
No other files touched (no deps, lockfile, settings, or test edits). No commit.

## Verification
- `npm test` → passes
- `shasum -a 256 tests/clamp.accept.test.mjs` → still a3866579…ce19
- `git status` → only `src/clamp.mjs` added
feedback: Also add tests/clamp-feedback.test.mjs that checks clamp(5, 5, 5) === 5. Then present the plan again.
